query:
SELECT 
  searchId,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signalOpeners IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_openers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signalOpeners IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_openers
FROM companies 
WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003)
GROUP BY searchId;
